subject: Private CP: IdP assertion proxy & SCIM lifecycle questions
messages:
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme-corp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: idp-team@acme-corp.com, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private CP identity integration constraints and questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we evaluate Redwood Private in our VPC, we need to finalize how identity and access will be integrated with our IdP. A few constraints and asks from our side: 

- The control plane instance will live in our VPC and must not initiate outbound connections to the public IdP endpoints except over explicitly approved egress (we can open to specific IPs).
- We want group-based role mapping (AD groups -> Redwood roles) and fast deprovisioning when users are removed from AD.
- SCIM must support delta sync for list/deprovision events; we cannot accept full reprovision every hour.
- Certificate rotation and SAML metadata updates need a documented rollover procedure we can run with our security team.
- Audit trail needs to include who issued a short-lived admin token and which assertion was used.

Questions: 1) Can Redwood support an IdP proxy in our VPC that terminates SAML and issues internal JWTs to the control plane? 2) How do you recommend mapping SAML attributes -> role binding in the Private CP when JIT provisioning is disabled? 3) Any constraints on SCIM rate limits and recommended polling/delta window?

Attached: idp-saml-metadata.xml for our test IdP and a draft provisioning matrix.

Looking for a design that passes our security review.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Director, Cloud Identity — Acme Corp


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme-corp.com>
Cc: idp-team@acme-corp.com, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private CP identity integration constraints and questions

Rajesh — thanks for the clear list. Below is a proposal that fits the VPC/no-outbound constraint while preserving auditability and fast deprovisioning. Please review and call out any compliance blockers.

Proposed pattern: "IdP assertion proxy" (deployed inside customer VPC)
- Component: control-plane-idp-proxy (small service you run in a private subnet).
- Function: terminates SAML (or LDAP-to-SAML bridge), validates assertions locally, exchanges assertion for a short-lived Redwood-signed JWT via a mutual-TLS call to the Private CP control plane API.
- Why: avoids the Private CP reaching out to the IdP; your proxy is the only component that speaks to IdP endpoints.

Key behaviors and recommendations:
1) Assertion TTL and JWT lifecycle
   - Proxy should issue JWTs with very short TTLs (5-15 minutes) for admin-level tokens.
   - For non-admin, session tokens can be 1 hour. All tokens contain original assertion id and IdP signature fingerprint for audit.

2) Role mapping
   - Map AD groups -> Redwood role IDs in a config file inside the proxy (yaml).
   - Proxy produces a role claim in the JWT (role_ids: ["infra-admin","viewer"]).
   - On token intake, the control plane enforces role bindings and ignores any JIT provisioning toggle—i.e., users must exist in the control plane directory.

3) SCIM provisioning
   - Support delta sync via SCIM 2.0 (PATCH + incremental queries).
   - We recommend push-style provisioning from your IdP to the proxy (if IdP supports webhooks) and proxy->Redwood SCIM with a delta window of ~5 minutes for critical accounts.
   - When push is not available, set delta polling to 5 minutes and include ETag/If-Modified semantics to reduce payloads.

4) Deprovisioning and audit
   - When a SCIM "active": false event is received, invalidate sessions and create a revoke event tied to the original assertion id.
   - All proxy->control-plane token exchanges are logged with assertion id, issuer, subject, and proxied IP. Logs are shipped to your SIEM (syslog/S3) with a hashed token id for correlation.

5) Certificate rotation
   - Proxy supports hot-swap of IdP metadata and certs. We recommend a rolling cert rotate with a 48-hour overlap window. Proxy exposes a health endpoint and /metadata/verify to validate new metadata before switch.

6) Air-gapped mode
   - For fully air-gapped installs (no egress at all), the proxy is extended to run an SFTP-based metadata ingestion workflow (signed bundle uploaded by your security team).

Next steps from Redwood: we can provide a reference proxy image and an example mapping yaml. I'll loop in Marcus to advise on SCIM rate-limits and runbook creation.

Action items: 
- Rajesh: confirm acceptable token TTL ranges and whether JIT provisioning is allowed for test users.
- IdP team: provide preferred group claim name (e.g., "groups" vs "memberOf").

Thanks — happy to jump on a follow-up call.

— Soojin
Staff PM, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Marcus / Aditya — forwarding Rajesh's thread and my proposed proxy approach. Key asks for engineering/runbook: 

- SCIM rate-limits and delta sync defaults (Rajesh expects 5-minute deprovisioning SLAs).
- How we persist assertion metadata in the CP audit logs (store assertion id + issuer fingerprint).
- Recommended config schema for group->role mapping and how to handle group renames.
- A documented cert-rotation playbook for the proxy (rolling swap + verify endpoint).

I've attached a skeleton provisioning matrix and the test IdP metadata. Please add notes inline in the sheet and propose a runbook outline.

Thanks — want to have a draft runbook for the security review by Tue EOD.

— Soojin

On Nov 26, 2026, at 08:05, Soojin Lee wrote:
> Rajesh — thanks for the clear list....
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private CP identity integration constraints and questions

Thanks for the context, Soojin. Notes below (copyable into the runbook):

1) SCIM rate-limits and delta behavior
   - Default: 1200 calls / hour per customer for provisioning endpoints. For critical delta syncs (deprovision events) we support a "burst" path up to 500 calls/min for a short window (5 minutes) when explicitly enabled in the proxy config.
   - Recommend: Configure proxy to do push -> proxy->SCIM immediate PATCH for account disables. When using polling, set interval to 300s and use If-None-Match headers to avoid heavy payloads.

2) Assertion metadata & audit storage
   - Persist: assertion_id, issuer_fingerprint (sha256 of IdP cert), subject, proxied_ip, token_jti.
   - Storage target: control plane audit index (immutable append log) + forward a copy to customer's S3 bucket (or syslog) for retention.

3) Group->role mapping schema (example YAML)
   - keys: group_source, group_id, role_id, match_type (exact|prefix|regex), fallback_role
   - On group rename: proxy resolves by group_id if available; if IdP only provides names, we provide a reconcile tool that compares previous sync snapshots and alerts on name drift.

4) Cert rotation playbook (high level)
   - Stage 0: Upload new metadata bundle to /metadata/staged, run /metadata/verify against test IdP endpoint.
   - Stage 1: Add new cert to trust store, keep old cert active (48h overlap).
   - Stage 2: Gradual traffic cutover with health-check gating; if any client fails, revert to old cert and open a ticket.

5) Edge cases: air-gapped installs
   - Provide signed metadata bundles and an offline signer tool. SCIM syncs run over an internal message queue; provisioning latency will be higher — call this out in SLA.

Deliverables: I'll draft the runbook sections for SCIM tuning, audit schema, and a template mapping YAML. Aditya — can you add the exact API schema for the token exchange (JWT claim names) and sample curl for revocation?

If Rajesh signs off on the token TTLs (5m admin / 1h non-admin), we can include those as recommended defaults in the playbook.

— Marcus
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
